about: Every non-ASCII codepoint in the page's source (board.html and web/board.css), classified against the unicode-range values web/fonts/plex.css declares (task 123). 'declared' is inside a range every Plex face declares; 'monoOnly' is inside Plex Mono's symbols2 range only; 'system' is inside no Plex range, so a system font draws it now as it did when the page linked Google Fonts. Declared is not proof that Plex has the glyph: verify/browser_cases/case_fonts.py draws each one and reports what it found. tests/test_font_bundle.py keeps this list equal to the page.

excluded.E000-E003: private-use sentinels md() swaps out before anything is drawn
